Repo: /Users/marcel.a.n.navarro/Dev/zimmermann-pwa. Branch: feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component (already checked out). Steps 1-2 already committed. Build Step 3 of the SFCC-236 plan ONLY.

## Step 3 — `ZimmProductPrice`: add opt-out `isLive` prop

Modify ONLY these 2 files (both already exist, do not create new files):
```
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx
overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.test.tsx
```
Do not touch `zimmProductPrice.css.ts` or `index.stories.tsx` unless you find a genuine need to add ONE new story variant (see below) — no other file anywhere.

## The problem
Read `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx` first, in full. It currently hardcodes `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` on its rendered output — correct on the PDP (WCAG SC 4.1.3: a variant/size change re-renders a different price, and a screen-reader user should hear that change). But this component is about to be reused inside a product CARD (SFCC-236's shared card, being built across other steps in this same PR) where up to 60 cards can appear on a single PLP grid — 60 live regions that never actually change after mount is unnecessary DOM overhead and unnecessary AT chatter for zero benefit.

## The fix
Add a new prop `isLive?: boolean` to the component's props type, defaulting to `true` (so ALL existing callers — the PDP usage that exists today — get byte-identical behaviour with zero code changes required on their end). When `isLive` is explicitly passed as `false`, do NOT render `aria-live` or `aria-atomic` at all (not `aria-live="off"` — omit the attributes entirely).

Apply this to BOTH the loaded/normal render path AND the `isLoading` skeleton render path if the component has one — read the full component first to find every place `aria-live`/`aria-atomic` currently appears (there may be more than one, e.g. a skeleton state) and gate all of them on the same `isLive` prop consistently.

## Critical constraint — this must be a strictly additive change
- Every existing prop stays exactly as-is, same names, same types, same defaults.
- Every existing behaviour (when `isLive` is not passed, i.e. every current call site) must produce byte-identical rendered output to what exists today — same DOM, same attributes, same values. This is not a refactor of the component, it's one new optional prop with one conditional.
- Do NOT reorder, rename, or restructure anything else in the file. Do not touch the component's other logic (Was/Now formatting, currency handling, etc.) at all.
- Do NOT change the recipe file (`zimmProductPrice.css.ts`) — this is a props/rendering change only, not a styling change.

## Test file
Read the existing `index.test.tsx` in full first. Add exactly two new test cases (do not modify or remove any existing test):
1. `isLive={false}` on the normal/loaded render path — assert neither `aria-live` nor `aria-atomic` attributes are present on the rendered output.
2. `isLive={false}` combined with whatever loading/skeleton state the component supports (if it has one) — assert the same (neither attribute present) in that branch too. If the component has no distinct loading/skeleton branch that also carries these attributes, skip this second case and say so in your report — do not invent a loading state that doesn't exist.

Also verify (by reading the existing tests, not by writing a new one) that the existing tests which check for `aria-live="polite"`/`aria-atomic="true"` on the DEFAULT (no `isLive` prop passed) case still pass unmodified — this proves the default behaviour is unchanged. If no such existing test exists asserting the default aria-live behaviour, that's worth noting too (it would mean this component's a11y contract was previously untested, not something to fix in this step, just report it).

## House rules
TypeScript only. No `any` without a comment. Australian spelling in comments if you add any (though a one-line prop addition may not need any new comments at all — the prop should be self-explanatory with a JSDoc line matching the style of the component's other props).

## Verify after the fix
```
npx tsc --noEmit
npx vitest run overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice
npx eslint overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice
node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs
npm run test
```
The full `npm run test` run must show the EXACT SAME pass count as before this step plus exactly the new test(s) you added (baseline going into this step: 49 files / 736 tests, after Step 2's commit) — confirm the new total and that nothing else changed count.

Also run a scoped check: does anything else in the codebase currently import/use `ZimmProductPrice`? (grep for it.) If so, confirm your change doesn't affect their rendered output — you're adding an opt-out default-true prop, so it shouldn't, but verify by reading each call site's usage.

Report exactly what changed (diff-style, before/after for the modified lines), confirm the file count stayes at 2 (or note if you also touched a story file and why), and confirm all verification commands are clean. Do NOT stage or commit.

`feature/SFCC-236_product-card-shared-component` (not `develop`/`main`).

**`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmProductPrice/index.tsx`**

1. Added `isLive?: boolean` to `ZimmProductPriceProps`, with JSDoc matching the style of the other props (explains the opt-out, the default, and that it's an omission not `aria-live="off"`):
```tsx
  isLoading?: boolean;
+ /**
+  * Opt out of the WCAG 4.1.3 live-region announcement (`aria-live`/`aria-atomic`) entirely.
+  * Defaults to `true` so every existing caller (the PDP, where a variant swap needs to be
+  * announced) keeps today's behaviour unchanged with no code change on their end. Pass `false`
+  * when this atom is reused inside a grid of many cards (e.g. a PLP) where the price never
+  * changes after mount, so a live region adds DOM/AT overhead for no benefit — the attributes
+  * are omitted entirely in that case, not set to `aria-live="off"`.
+  */
+ isLive?: boolean;
};
```
2. Destructured it with a default of `true`:
```diff
-export const ZimmProductPrice = ({ currentPrice, originalPrice, isLoading }: ZimmProductPriceProps) => {
+export const ZimmProductPrice = ({ currentPrice, originalPrice, isLoading, isLive = true }: ZimmProductPriceProps) => {
```
3. Computed the two ARIA attributes once, gated by `isLive`, right after `useIntl()`:
```tsx
const liveRegionProps: { 'aria-live'?: 'polite'; 'aria-atomic'?: 'true' } = isLive
```
